tools.name: find_locations
tools.description: Find High Focus Centers outpatient locations, optionally filtered by state (nj, pa, ct, ga) or city name. Returns address, phone, and page URL.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Get High Focus Centers admissions contact details and the URLs for starting admissions or verifying insurance.

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: List the outpatient treatment programs offered by High Focus Centers, with a short summary and page URL for each.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter programs by title or summary, e.g. 'trauma' or 'adolescent'.

tools.name: navigate_site
tools.description: Open a page on the High Focus Centers site, such as a program or location page returned by the other tools.
